_comment: An example `models` block that mixes tools. Legwork may run anywhere, cheapest first: Command Code, then Codex's small model, then a cheap OpenRouter model through opencode (paid per token, so last). Judging (the review and the challenge) runs only on the tools in `judges`: when every judge is out of limit or credit, `deputy model` exits with code 3 and the run does that stage itself, so a model limit never stops the work. OpenRouter is never a judge here. Use the model names your own accounts offer.
